1. List revised.
2. Sri Ashok Kumar Yadav, Advocate files files his vakalatnama on behalf of opposite party no.2, the same is taken on record.

3. Heard Shri Ramakant Singh, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Ashok Kumar Yadav, learned counsel for the opposite party no.2, Sri Triveni Saran Rai, learned counsel for the State and perused the material brought on record.
4.

The present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicant-Amit Chauhan with the prayer to allow the present application on the basis of compromise dated 18.3.2024 and Amit Chauhan vs State Of U.P. And Another on 16 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/139335644/

sentences.text: 5. Learned counsel for the applicant argued that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the present case.

It is argued that the applicant and opposite party no.2 have settled their dispute out of Court and a compromise dated 18.3.2024 has been entered into between them, copy of the same is annexed as annexure no.7 to the affidavit.
It is submitted that in view of the same, the proceedings against the applicant deserves to be quashed.

6. Per contra, learned counsel for the state points out that the applicant has been avoiding the process of law since the last four years inasmuch as the applicant ws summoned by the trial court vide order dated 18.5.2020 after filing of charge sheet after which cognizance order passed and since then he has failed to appear before the court concerned due to which bailable warrant and then non-bailable warrant have been issued against the applicant, as such his request cannot be accepted since he has been avoiding the process of law and evading the call of the court.

7. On countering the learned counsel for the applicant, he submits that the applicant could not appear before the court concerned in response to the call through summoning order and then through non-bailable warrant also.
Since the parties have entered into a compromise, the matter be quashed.
8. After having heard learned counsel for both the parties and perusing the records, it is evident that the applicant has been absconding and has not appeared before the trial court since 18.5.2020.
As of now and considering the matter on the basis of compromise is not in the fitness of things since the same is dated 18.3.2024 which is after four years of his abscondance.

The applicant should have cared to honour the orders of the court concerned summoning him and then bailable warrant and non-bailable warrant.
9.
In view of the same, the present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. stands dismissed.

(Samit Gopal, J.) Order Date :- 16.5.2024 Gaurav Kuls  Amit Chauhan vs State Of U.P. And Another on 16 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/139335644/
